mapper.insert: insert into tenant (tenant_code, tenant_name, status, created_by_user_id) values (#{tenantCode}, #{tenantName}, #{status}, #{createdByUserId})
mapper.select: select t.tenant_id, t.tenant_code, t.tenant_name, t.status, r.role_code from tenant_member m inner join tenant t on t.tenant_id = m.tenant_id inner join tenant_role r on r.role_id = m.role_id and r.tenant_id = m.tenant_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.member_status = #{memberStatus} order by t.tenant_id desc
